title: WEBTOON Launches 1st Global Drop With The Warrior's Ballad
content: WEBTOON Entertainment has launched its first "Global Drop" project with The Warrior's Ballad , releasing the fantasy webtoon simultaneously in nine languages on September 19. Global Drop is a new initiative that releases highly anticipated new and returning webtoons in multiple languages without a time delay between…
author: ANN

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Reveals Additional Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyuu Takahata and Yuuji Kaba 's Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) manga revealed additional staff, a character visual (pictured above), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Snowball Earth Manga Heads to Final Arc, Exceeds 1 Million Copies in Circulation
content: Manga author Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday that their Snowball Earth manga has exceeded 1 million copies in circulation. Additionally, Tsujitsugu announced that the manga is starting its final arc.
author: ANN

title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's 1st Full Promo Video Unveils More Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga presented the anime's first full promotional video and character visuals on Thursday. The video announces additional staff members and the January 2027 premiere for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Bless Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed two more cast members in a character promotional video, on Thursday. Yoshino Aoyama will voice Oroka Sumeragi, and Momoka Terasawa will voice Shitataka Sumeragi.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight and Final Opening Featuring "LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!" by Going Under Ground
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight and final opening, featuring the song “LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!” by Going Under Ground. The song was used in Episodes 178-203, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World 2nd Season Anime Casts Shiki Aoki, Kazuyuki Okitsu
content: The website for the second season of the television anime based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series revealed two additional cast members on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love TV Anime Reveals New Visual, 4 More Cast Members
content: Kadokawa revealed more cast and a new visual on Thursday for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai. ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Main Cast & Staff Members, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser visual, main cast and staff members, and its 2027 debut.
author: ANN

title: 'Bless' Unveils Additional Cast, Character Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga unveiled additional cast and the character promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV's NoitaminA programming block at 11.30. p.m. in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
